flavor: Spring-assisted, half-serrated. Opens one-handed. You've opened it ten thousand times.
name: Multitool

baseEffect: Fire on demand (until fuel runs out)
flavor: The most valuable object in the post-Burn world. Guard it with your life.
name: Lighter

baseEffect: Stabilize one severe injury per expedition
flavor: Not much left in the kit. Enough for one bad day.
name: Field Sutures

flavor: Crayon on printer paper: you, holding a sun. She drew it the week before the sky changed.
name: Daughter's Drawing
memory: Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later.

reveals.note: She used to pick the bitter greens by the fence. You know them now: dandelion, edible.

baseEffect: Quiet, broken-in, still holding. (Bond to unlock more.)
flavor: Broken in over three states. They fit like a promise.
name: Good Boots

baseEffect: Dress game 25% faster; +bond with every kill cleaned
flavor: Grandfather's. The edge remembers.
name: Grandfather's Knife

flavor: Coiled the way their grandfather taught them.
name: Rope 50Ft

flavor: Dented. Older than you.
name: Tin Cup

flavor: Hasn't taken it off since the sky changed.
name: Camo Jacket

baseEffect: Butcher and fillet with precision; +bond with every meal prepared
flavor: Eleven years of mornings. The edge is a meditation.
name: Chef's Knife

flavor: Small, grey, irreplaceable.
name: Whetstone

baseEffect: Fish anywhere there's water and patience
flavor: 200 yards, wrapped around a stick. Low-tech, high-yield.
name: Fishing Line

flavor: Mother's. Twisted when thinking.
name: Mother's Ring
memory: The winter the factory closed {kin} pressed this into your hand and said: fix what you can reach. She twisted it when she was thinking, which was always. You twist it now.

reveals.note: Her voice, patient: measure twice. Things can be fixed.

name: Tote Bag
flavor: Canvas, thirty-one years of bus routes. Currently holds: everything.
memory: Thirty-one years of bus routes in this canvas. The driver on the 42 used to wait when he saw you running — all those years, he waited. You never learned his name. You think about him at every campfire.

reveals.note: The depot on 5th — buses, tools, dry storage. If anyone is left, they would be there.

name: Reading Glasses
flavor: For the ledger and the fine print on cans. The apocalypse has fine print.
memory: You read the fine print on medicine bottles for {kin} next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.

reveals.note: The broad-leafed weed by every path — a poultice for stings and bites. You read about it once.

name: Bus Schedule
flavor: The 42, laminated. Kept to remind the universe about punctuality.
memory: The 42. 6:14, 6:44, 7:14 — never late, even the last week, when the driver ran an empty bus through an empty city because the schedule said so.

reveals.note: You always know which way is home. Mostly.

name: Hard Candy
flavor: Butterscotch. Dole them out like medals.
memory: Butterscotch, doled out like medals — good report card, brave dentist visit, the day the dog died. Small sweetness, on purpose.

reveals.note: You know how to make a bad day smaller for someone.

name: Spare Socks
flavor: Dry socks are civilization. This has always been known.
memory: The flood year, three days in wet boots. Your feet went white and strange. The medic packed them with yarrow and told you: dry socks are civilization. Never again, you said.

reveals.note: Yarrow — white flowers, feathery leaves. Stops bleeding. The medic taught you.

name: Dead Phone
flavor: Cracked screen, 2% forever. Kept the way sailors kept compasses.
memory: Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from {kin} — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out there.

reveals.note: Your brother — last known heading west. Someone, somewhere, might have seen him.

name: Hoodie
flavor: Smells like dorm laundry and rain. Armor, basically.
memory: Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically.

reveals.note: You can smell weather coming. Storms rarely surprise you.

name: Energy Bar Wrapper
flavor: Empty. The nutrition label gets read when numbers are missed.
memory: Empty. You used to read the nutrition label when you missed numbers — calories, protein, the math of staying alive. Funny, the math that matters now.

reveals.note: White oak mast — sweetest of the acorns, food if you know the work. You know the work.

name: Notebook
flavor: Half route notes, half apocalypse patch notes. A magnum opus.
memory: Route optimizations, glitch lists, apocalypse patch notes. 'DO NOT TRUST THE CACHE BY THE RIVER.' Your magnum opus, half-finished.

reveals.note: Page 12: deadfall diagrams. You remember drawing them.

name: Stethoscope
flavor: Hear a heartbeat through anything. Useful for people. Useless for the System.

name: Bandana
flavor: Sling, bandage, filter, flag. The most versatile square of cloth ever made.

name: Protein bar
flavor: Tastes like cardboard. 200 kcal of cardboard.

name: Snare wire
flavor: Thin, strong, patient. The rabbit doesn't know it's there until it does.

name: Trail mix
flavor: Nuts, raisins, chocolate. The chocolate is gone. The hope remains.

name: Binoculars
flavor: See far. The far is mostly trees. But sometimes it's dinner.

name: Chopsticks
flavor: Not just for eating. For picking, probing, and pointing at things.

name: Soy packets
flavor: Six little packets. Salt is civilization.

name: Bus map
flavor: Every route marked. None of them go here.

name: Phone charger
flavor: No phone, no outlet. But it's a really good cable.

name: Energy drink
flavor: 300mg of caffeine. For emergencies. Everything is an emergency.

name: Dice set
flavor: For when decisions need to be fast and blame needs to be random.

name: Calculator
flavor: The pantry math must be exact. Estimating is how pantries die.

name: Pen set
flavor: Blue, black, red. For writing, underlining, and correcting.

name: Tasting spoon
flavor: A chef tastes everything. Even the apocalypse.

name: Thermos
flavor: Keeps things hot. Hot is a memory now.

name: Photo album
flavor: Faces from before. The most valuable thing they own.
memory: Faces from before. {kin}'s wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.

reveals.note: Your sister — she was visiting the coast. The coast is far. Far is not gone.

name: Sharpened stick
flavor: a stick, whittled to a point

name: Stone knife
flavor: flint knapped to an edge, bound with vine

name: Hunting spear
flavor: long, balanced, stone-tipped

name: Kitchen knife
flavor: scavenged from a ruin, still sharp

name: Bark armor
flavor: bark lashed with vine. Better than skin.

name: Leather jacket
flavor: scavenged. Smells like someone else's life.

name: Riot gear
flavor: police surplus. Heavy, hot, stops a boar.

name: Military vest
flavor: plate carrier, no plates. Still better than nothing.

name: Sling
flavor: Two cords and a pouch. David's technology, still working.

name: Fire-hardened spear
flavor: The tip is black and hard as iron. Fire did half the work.

name: Hatchet
flavor: Chops wood. Chops other things. The edge doesn't judge.

name: Machete
flavor: Clears brush. Clears problems. Still has the price sticker.

name: Crude bow
flavor: Bent stick, twisted cord. The arrows are straighter than the bow.

name: Padded cloth wraps
flavor: Layers of cloth tied tight. Better than skin. Barely.

name: Hide armor
flavor: Cured hide, laced with sinew. Smells like work.

name: SWAT vest
flavor: Ceramic plates in a carrier that says PROPERTY OF. Nobody's property now.

name: Tinder bundle
flavor: Char cloth, fatwood shavings, dry bark. Fire in a pouch.

name: Rope coil
flavor: 50 feet of paracord. The most useful thing ever made.
baseEffect: Climb, drag, bind. +1 to trap crafting

name: Sewing kit
flavor: Needles, thread, buttons in a tin. Civilization in miniature.
baseEffect: Repair clothing/armor. +trust when mending for others

name: Pitch torch
flavor: Pine pitch on a stick. Burns an hour. Smokes.
baseEffect: Light in dark places. Scares most animals

name: Hand drill
flavor: Spindle and hearth board. Friction is free.
baseEffect: Make fire anywhere (takes a day part)

name: Gill net
flavor: Monofilament net, 10 feet. Illegal in twelve states. All of them gone.
baseEffect: Passive: catches fish while you do other things

name: Field dressing kit
flavor: Gut hook, bone saw, game bags. The respectful way.
baseEffect: Dress game 50% faster; meat keeps longer

name: Dried apples
flavor: Chewy rings. Tastes like fall.

name: Pemmican
flavor: Dried meat pounded with fat and berries. The original energy bar.

name: Hardtack
flavor: Flour, water, salt, baked to stone. The cracker that outlives empires.
baseEffect: 300 kcal. Break a tooth or eat forever.

name: Canned beans
flavor: The can is dented. The beans don't care.

name: Peanut butter jar
flavor: Half full. The oil separated. Stir it with a stick like an animal.

name: Trail mix
flavor: Nuts, raisins, chocolate chips (melted, reformed, still good).

name: Wedding ring
flavor: Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day.
memory: Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day — the rain, the borrowed suit, the laughter during the vows. Grief is just love with nowhere to go.

reveals.note: This one channels harder than the rest. Love with nowhere to go.

name: Mixtape
flavor: Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway.
memory: Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster.

reveals.note: You sing while you work. The work remembers the rhythm.

name: Dog tags
flavor: Not yours. You carry them so someone is remembered.
memory: Not yours. {kin}'s. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. {kin} would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.

reveals.note: {kin} taught you to read ground. You never forgot.

name: Wool socks
flavor: Dry feet are happy feet. The first rule.

name: Rain poncho
flavor: Crackly plastic. Smells like a hardware store. Keeps you dry.

name: Crowbar
flavor: Opens doors. Opens cans. Opens arguments.

name: Venison jerky
flavor: Smoked over hickory. Chewy as a promise.

name: Hiking Backpack
flavor: A real backpack. +10kg carry. Padded straps. Hip belt. Someone loved this pack. Now it loves you.

name: Duffel Bag
flavor: Big and awkward. +7kg carry. Smells faintly of gym socks and freedom. Holds a LOT.

name: Work Gloves
flavor: Leather palms, canvas backs. Smell like every job ever done.

name: Canvas Pants
flavor: Double-kneed, thorn-proof-ish. Pockets deep enough to lose things in.
baseEffect: Carry a little more. (Bond to unlock more.)

name: Flannel Shirt
flavor: Red and black check. Warm even damp — wool doesn't care about rain.

name: Knit Cap
flavor: Hand-knit, slightly lopsided. Someone loved whoever wore this.
baseEffect: Keeps the heat in. (Bond to unlock more.)

name: Denim Jacket
flavor: Broken-in denim, brass buttons. Armor for people who don't own armor.

name: Running Shoes
flavor: Light, fast, already half-dead. Speed has a price.

name: Rain Shell
flavor: Ultralight, packs to nothing. The zipper still works. Miracles happen.

name: Hand Saw
flavor: Folding pruning saw. Cuts on the pull, like it means it.

name: Camp Pot
flavor: Dented aluminum, blackened base. Has cooked a thousand meals. Hungry for more.

name: Brass Locket
flavor: Two photos inside, both fading. Opens with a click you can feel in your teeth.
memory: Brass. Two photos inside, both fading. It opens with a click you can feel in your teeth — {kin}'s click, then your mother's, now yours.

reveals.note: The farmhouse upstate, in the photos. Root cellar, well, far from everything.

name: Lucky Coin
flavor: Worn smooth. Heads or tails, it always lands on keep going.
memory: Worn smooth. {kin} flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

reveals.note: Quiet luck follows you. Small things break your way.

name: Beat-up Paperback
flavor: A field guide to edible plants, ironically. Spine cracked at the mushroom chapter.
memory: A field guide to edible plants, ironically. Spine cracked at the mushroom chapter — you were always going to learn mushrooms, someday. Someday is now.

reveals.note: Jewelweed — the orange touch-me-not by creeks. Poison ivy’s antidote. The book taught you.

name: Wood log
flavor: A solid log. Building material. Future walls start here.

name: Arrow
flavor: straight, fletched, meant for something living

name: Branch
flavor: Deadfall and pruned limbs. Burns well. Future: handles, stakes, walls.

name: Plant fiber
flavor: Stripped bark and tough stems. Future: cordage, snares, cloth.

name: Stone
flavor: Good hard stone. Sling ammo, tool heads, future foundations.
